contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001 (all Q-coefficient). Compatible with and complementary to corroborated FND-0064 (the forgetful map Conf_6(C/B^{bal})→ relative degree-six effective-divisor space is a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections) and with FND-0051/FND-0060 (stack vs coarse and Aut-invariants discipline, but those target stable-graph boundary strata and Hurwitz coarse dimension, not this S_6 configuration model). Independent primary checks. (1) Stack torsor: S_6 acts freely on ordered pairwise-distinct sections of a smooth curve family, so Conf_6→U_red is a principal S_6-bundle (finite étale of degree 720) as a map of algebraic stacks/configuration stacks—this is the content of FND-0064 and standard relative configuration geometry. (2) Coarse failure: at geometric points where Aut(C) (or residual automorphisms of the moduli object) permutes the marked support, residual stabilizers make the induced map of coarse spaces not an S_6-torsor (not a free finite étale principal bundle in the scheme/coarse category); descent that quotes only the torsor model therefore requires the stack. (3) Q-invariants vs coinvariants: for finite G with |G| invertible in the coefficient ring R (here G=S_6, |G|=720, R=Q), the averaging/norm maps give canonical isomorphisms M^G≅M_G for R[G]-modules, so H^*(ordered;Q)^{S_6}≅H^*(ordered;Q)_{S_6} and rational descent along the stack torsor is harmless. (4) Integral and pure-coarse: over Z, invariants and coinvariants need not agree and transfer introduces torsion; Edidin (arXiv:1006.2364) constructs integral stack/equivariant cohomology and proves only a rational isomorphism between quotient DM-stack cohomology and coarse-space cohomology—so the same descent is not free integrally and the geometric S_6-torsor model itself is unavailable on coarse moduli. (5) Campaign scope: RED-0001 / C66 targets use Q, so the obstruction does not block a correctly stated stack-level Q-coefficient C66-TATE-* argument, but any integral-coefficient or coarse-space rewrite built on this ordered model needs independent justification—as the finding states. Distinct from FND-0064 (positive torsor existence only), FND-0051 (Aut(Γ) Gysin bookkeeping), and FND-0060 (coarse vs stack dimension of balanced tetragonal base): do not merge. Merge target: none. Promote candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent primary-source verification of the stack torsor, coarse residual-automorphism failure, and Q vs integral/coarse descent.
